mapper.select: select ta.id, ta.factory_id, ta.item_type_id, ta.attr_id, ta.required, ta.sort_order, ta.enable_flag, d.attr_code, d.attr_name, d.attr_type, d.attr_unit, CAST(d.options_json AS CHAR) as options_json_str, 0 as inherit_depth from qxx_md_item_type_attr ta join qxx_md_attr_def d on d.attr_id = ta.attr_id where ta.factory_id = #{factoryId} and ta.item_type_id = #{itemTypeId} and ta.enable_flag = '1' order by ta.sort_order, ta.id

with recursive ancestor_types as ( select item_type_id, parent_type_id, 0 as depth from qxx_md_item_type where item_type_id = #{itemTypeId} and factory_id = #{factoryId} union all select t.item_type_id, t.parent_type_id, a.depth + 1 from qxx_md_item_type t join ancestor_types a on t.item_type_id = a.parent_type_id where t.factory_id = #{factoryId} ) select merged.id, merged.factory_id, merged.item_type_id, merged.attr_id, merged.required, merged.sort_order, merged.enable_flag, merged.attr_code, merged.attr_name, merged.attr_type, merged.attr_unit, merged.options_json_str, merged.inherit_depth from ( select ta.id, ta.factory_id, ta.item_type_id, ta.attr_id, ta.required, ta.sort_order, ta.enable_flag, d.attr_code, d.attr_name, d.attr_type, d.attr_unit, CAST(d.options_json AS CHAR) as options_json_str, a.depth as inherit_depth, row_number() over (partition by ta.attr_id order by a.depth asc) as rn from qxx_md_item_type_attr ta join ancestor_types a on a.item_type_id = ta.item_type_id join qxx_md_attr_def d on d.attr_id = ta.attr_id where ta.factory_id = #{factoryId} and ta.enable_flag = '1' ) merged where merged.rn = 1 order by merged.inherit_depth desc, merged.sort_order, merged.id
mapper.insert: insert into qxx_md_item_type_attr (factory_id, item_type_id, attr_id, required, sort_order, enable_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{factoryId}, #{itemTypeId}, #{attrId}, #{required}, #{sortOrder}, #{enableFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from qxx_md_item_type_attr where factory_id = #{factoryId} and item_type_id = #{itemTypeId}
